Unstructured data marking, as a business empowering tool that supports intelligent processing of multi\-modal data, can help enterprises integrate multi\-channel unstructured data and convert text, voice, image, video and other unstructured data into standardized business labels. Support multi\-source data access, custom labeling systems, and labeled data output to help enterprises build reusable label assets and drive intelligent analysis and decision\-making.

<span id="6047e748"></span>
# Function Introduction

By integrating multi\-channel unstructured data such as WeCom dialogues, outbound call recordings, and intelligent voice experience, we can conduct conversation overview, conversation original query, conversation marking, understand users' evaluation and suggestions on products, services, marketing, and other aspects, and evaluate session quality, providing reference for business operations; mining the intentions and preferences of individual users and groups, deeply understanding users, better operating users, and providing assistance for enterprise growth. Support for marking unstructured data such as articles, images (e.g. product images), videos (e.g. product introduction videos), etc.

<span id="0af650e9"></span>
# Application Scenario

It is widely applicable to multiple industries and scenarios. In the field of customer service, it is possible to extract labels from a large amount of conversation data to quickly understand customer needs, problem types, etc. In the field of marketing, it is possible to analyze social media data, user comments, etc. to extract user interest labels and assist in accurate marketing.

<span id="50057c39"></span>
# Prerequisite

When using the unstructured data marking function of the conversation assistant, you also need to activate VeCDP and Volcano Engine Ark products simultaneously. The unstructured data marking function depends on these two products to achieve. For specific opening methods, please refer to the [Customer Data Platform Product Online Purchase Guide ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6356/1131835)and [Volcano Ark Big Model Service Quick Start](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1399008).


|Dependent product |functional dependency specification |Precautions |fee description |
|---|---|---|---|
|VeCDP |* The unstructured data marking function is based on the visual modeling function of VeCDP. The restful operator is called for data processing by creating a visual modeling task, and the large model operator is used for smart label output.<br><br>* Unstructured data needs to be integrated into the VeCDP dataset, and the unstructured data to be marked is integrated through the VeCDP dataset.<br><br>* The results of labeling unstructured data can be stored in VeCDP as label data for further use. |VeCDP needs to be under the same account as the unstructured data marking function. |In the subsequent use of the unstructured data marking function, if the function\-related expenses of these two products (such as the expenses incurred by large model calls) are incurred, the expenses will be counted separately in the corresponding product bill and will not be merged into the marketing interaction assistant Agent bill. |
|Volcano Engine Ark Platform |The unstructured data marking function supports docking with the Volcano Engine Ark platform through large model operators. Users only need to complete the large model access point and Token configuration on the platform, and then they can call the intelligent labelling capability to generate label results in real time. |* The currently supported large model types are those already available on the ARK platform that you call.<br><br>* Third\-party large models are subject to the OpenAPI standard protocol. ||
|Other products |At present, it is not supported to directly import unstructured data into VeCDP as a dataset. You need to store unstructured data in database & table first, and then create a dataset of VeCDP by docking with database & table. Therefore, you can use the appropriate database & table storage product according to the current way of creating datasets supported by VeCDP. |||


<span id="2a5fdb12"></span>
# Term Explanation


|Noun |Explanation |
|---|---|
|Project |It is an independent "space" for using the product. Except for the shared server hardware resources, the rest of the resources between the projects are isolated independently. For example, user permissions and data resources are different in Project A and Project B. |
|Project Center \- Users |The user of the product needs to be created in the Volcano Engine access control, with information such as project, account number, email address, and phone number. |
|Project Center \- User Group |A user group is a group of users with a specific business meaning that belongs to a project and cannot be used across projects. It needs to be created independently in the project center authorization management. |
|Module |The functional modules of the product correspond to their respective menus. Support module permission authorization in the project center. |
|Resource |The user produces resources in the product, such as labels, datasets, target groups, insight reports, and visual modeling tasks. Support resource permission authorization in the project center (user grouping and user insight authorization are operated on the details page). |
|Data |It refers specifically to the labels, datasets, etc. in the product, which can limit the range of ID assets that users can use through rules; it can also control data application scenarios, tables, and column fields available to users. |

# Operation Process

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning" data-tips-is-title="true">warning</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="warning">To avoid compatibility issues, we recommend that you use the latest version of Google Chrome browser to access the platform.</div>


The main operation process for configuring unstructured data marking tasks is as follows:


1. Open VeCDP customer data platform, please refer to [Open VeCDP ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6356/1131835)and [Authorization Configuration](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Authorization_Configuration).

2. Before using the unstructured data marking function, you need to create the unstructured data to be labeled as a dataset of VeCDP, see for details [Data Preparation](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Data_Preparation).

3. Create a visual modeling task and configure the data connection, see [Task Creation](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Task_Creation_).

4. Configure the relevant operators to handle unstructured data, see [Unstructured Data Processing Operators Configuration](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Unstructured_Data_Processing_Operators_Configuration).

5. Configure the final output and save form of unstructured data, see details [Processing Result Output Configuration](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Processing_Result_Output_Configuration).

6. For permission operations on account, user, label, and other functions in unstructured data marking, see [Authorization Configuration](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/dataagent/Authorization_Configuration).
